reviews.title: Great card, true MSRP price and nice quality and performance
reviews.comment:
Pros:
- The price is really the MSRP price, not as Nvidia that promises 799 dollars for the 4070 ti, but there is no card at that price anywhere
- Good quality material, mostly all the card is metal
- Good temperatures  during long play video games session, I'm talking more than 14 hours continuously, around 70 C
Cons: sometimes could be a little bit loud
You won't go wrong with this card, I know that is expensive, but, is the best price-performance deal that you can get right now, I'm playing videos games such as Elden ring and cyberpunk at 1440p max setting without no issues and my pc is: 650 Watt PSU, AMD 5600 and 16 GB of RAM.

reviews.title: Card died in about an hour, GREAT SELLER!
reviews.comment:
NOTHING to do with the seller. Seller was great in every way!
The card failed in about an hour. RMA'd it, took about 7 days to get the refund. The card was great for the few little while it ran. Now I'm scared to buy another AMD card. 😞
reviews.author: K. Lloyd

reviews.title: Great performance terrible software
reviews.comment:
This card is fantastic so far. The temperatures are really good. When my PC is idle, you can’t hear the fan running. When it’s under load, it ramps up, but it’s not bad. Also, when your game needs to download shaders, you’ll hear it ram a bit high, but it quickly goes down once it’s finished. As for FPS, I was able to play The Last of Us Part 1 on PC at max settings and get around 90-100 FPS. The size is a bit on the long side, but compared to the 40 and 50 series, it’s much more reasonable. I didn’t have any issues with the insulation. The only complaints I have about it. Is this software, but that is aging slowly like fine wine.
Edit: End of 2025 update. Removing star.
Software has gotten worse. Random hard lock/freeze will happen randomly no matter a load. If I don’t kill the power in time it will cause one of the two monitors to stop displaying a feed. Restart wouldn’t change must time nor would changing the cable ONLY removing the gpu driver and reinstall would it come back. I’m temped to change back to team green unfortunately.
